label: This sample runs the SOCA EFA validation benchmark across a multi-node MPI cluster. It verifies EFA hardware presence, runs OpenMPI ring + alltoall tests, measures NIC saturation via OSU MBW_MR, and produces a structured pass/fail report. Learn more.
EFA-capable instance type (instance_type)
description: Only EFA-capable instances are listed. For full bandwidth testing, use HPC-family (hpc6id, hpc7a, hpc8a) or compute-optimized network instances (c6in, c7gn, c8gn).
name: instance_type

values.label: hpc6id.32xlarge — 64 vCPU, 1024 GiB, 2x100 Gbps EFA (200 Gbps)
hpc7a.96xlarge — 192 vCPU, 768 GiB, 2x150 Gbps EFA (300 Gbps)
hpc8a.96xlarge — 192 vCPU, 768 GiB, 2x150 Gbps EFA (300 Gbps)
c8gn.48xlarge — 192 vCPU, 384 GiB, 2x300 Gbps EFA (600 Gbps)
c5n.18xlarge — 72 vCPU, 192 GiB, 1x100 Gbps EFA (1st-gen, no rdma-read)

label: Number of nodes
description: Minimum 2 nodes required for cross-node MPI tests. 4-8 nodes recommended for representative benchmark results.
name: node_count

label: MPI ranks per node (ncpus_per_node)
description: Should match the physical core count of the chosen instance type so Phase 7 (full-cores saturation, the headline benchmark) runs. If smaller than physical cores, Phase 7 will SKIP. Common values: hpc6id.32xlarge=64, hpc6a.48xlarge=96, hpc7a.96xlarge / hpc8a.96xlarge / c8gn.48xlarge=192, c7gn.16xlarge=64, c6in.32xlarge=64 (physical cores; SMT-on hardware), c5n.18xlarge=36.
name: ncpus_per_node

label: Operating system
description: Recommended: amazonlinux2023 (most thoroughly validated). RHEL/Rocky/Ubuntu also supported.
name: base_os

label: Job name (job_name)
description: Used as the scheduler job name and prefixed onto the output file. No spaces or special characters.
name: job_name

label: Walltime override
description: Set conservatively. Default 30 minutes is sufficient for hpc6id/hpc7a/hpc8a 2-node smoke runs; full-cores Alltoall sweep on 8 nodes may need 60+ minutes.
name: walltime

label: Additional pre-exec commands (user_pre_exec)
description: Optional shell commands to run before efa_test_job.sh. Useful for setting custom env vars or activating module files.
name: user_pre_exec
